question.problem: Suppose $v$ is directly proportional to $u.$ Given that $v=-12$ when $u=3$, find the value of $v$ when $u=5.${{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
Since $v$ varies directly with $u,$ we use the equation

$$
v=ku.
$$

We are told that $v=-12$ when $u=3.$ We substitute this data into the equation to find $k:$

$$
\begin{aligned}-12 & =k\cdot 3 \\ \frac{(-12)}{3} & =k \\ -4 & =k\end{aligned}
$$

So, the direct variation equation is given by

$$
v=-4u.
$$

Finally, substituting the value of $u=5$ into this equation gives

$$
\begin{aligned}v & =-4\cdot 5=-20.\end{aligned}
$$
